readme.note: ctx.inputs/ctx.outputs demo. Requestor sends a value to Router over a plain ('c') connector. Router fans out to two targets: Approval Service over a stream ('s') connector, and Audit Log over a plain ('c') connector. Step or Run Simulation, then check the Message Log (left sidebar): every tick, Router loops through ctx.inputs and logs each incoming connector's type plus the SENDING part's own type, then loops through ctx.outputs and logs each outgoing connector's type plus the RECEIVING part's own type -- all without hardcoding any neighbor's id.

parts.label: Requestor
parts.description: Sends a fresh request value to Router every tick, over a plain ('c') connector.
parts.script:
const req = 'REQ-' + ctx.tick;
return { value: req, state: {}, leftBadge: { text: req, color: '#2f8f4e' } };

parts.label: Router
parts.description: Loops ctx.inputs and ctx.outputs and logs each connector's type plus the OTHER part's own type to the Message Log -- see the readme note above.

parts.label: Approval Service
parts.description: One of Router's two outputs -- reached over a stream ('s') connector.

parts.label: Audit Log
parts.description: The other of Router's two outputs -- reached over a plain ('c') connector.
